task.description: Re-check ELIXIR-DEV's rework1 fix (commit be3f9e88) of the two @spec correctness defects this REVIEWER found at step-02d in lib/letflow/repository.ex's create/2 and list_versions/4.
acceptance_criteria: create/2's @spec is a complete and accurate union of every error it can actually return
list_versions/4's @spec is a complete and accurate union of every error it can actually return, with only real atoms named
No behavior change introduced alongside the spec fix

result.summary:
Independently re-traced every reachable error path in both functions against the CURRENT file state (not a diff against the prior version) and confirm both @specs are now complete and accurate.

create/2 (repository.ex:97-122): with-chain calls Canonicaliser.canonicalize_content/2 (confirmed canonicaliser.ex:100-115 -- only returns {:ok,_} | {:error,:invalid_json}, no other atom possible) then TenantProvisioning.tenant_id_for_schema_name/1 (confirmed tenant_provisioning.ex:193-208 -- {:ok,tenant_id} | {:error,:invalid_schema_name}). Falls through to create_with_retries/7, whose zero-retries base clause (line 124-126) returns {:error,:version_number_conflict} directly, and whose recursive clause bottoms out at {:ok,version} or {:error,%Ecto.Changeset{}}. Full union: {:ok, ArtifactVersion.t()} | {:error,:invalid_json} | {:error,:invalid_schema_name} | {:error,:version_number_conflict} | {:error, Ecto.Changeset.t()} -- exactly matches the current @spec at repository.ex:97-102. Nothing missing, nothing extra.

list_versions/4 (repository.ex:235-264): with-chain calls tenant_id_for_schema_name/1 (same :invalid_schema_name path), Pagination.validate_page_size/1 (confirmed pagination.ex:144-155 -- only real error atom is :page_size_too_large; :invalid_page_size belongs to the unrelated parse_page_size_param/1, never called on this path), then decode_list_versions_cursor/1 (repository.ex:274-287), which collapses Pagination.decode_cursor/4's possible errors (confirmed pagination.ex:207-220: :invalid_base64, :wrong_endpoint, :expired, and an implicit invalid-cursor case) down to exactly {:error,:wrong_endpoint} | {:error,:expired} | {:error,:invalid_cursor} via its own case/catch-all (the :invalid_base64 case is explicitly remapped to :invalid_cursor at line 285, never escapes under its own name). Full union: {:ok, Pagination.Page.t(ArtifactVersion.t())} | {:error,:invalid_schema_name} | {:error,:page_size_too_large} | {:error,:wrong_endpoint} | {:error,:expired} | {:error,:invalid_cursor} -- exactly matches the current @spec at repository.ex:241-246.

Behavior-change check: `git show be3f9e88 -- lib/letflow/repository.ex` shows only 5 changed lines, all inside the two @spec declarations (2 additions to create/2's union, 1 replacement + 1 addition in list_versions/4's union). No function body, guard clause, pattern match, or private helper touched. Confirmed spec-only, no behavior modification.

Both findings from step-02d are resolved. No new defect introduced by the rework. PASS -- gate cleared, routing to TEST-DESIGNER.
